criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: The 199-char opening stands alone and does all three jobs: names the news trigger with its date, names the mechanism, and signals the correction without snark. Held back from 10 only because the magnitude that makes it matter, thirty years decided on a fifteen-day window, lands in paragraph two, below the see-more cut.
criteria.why: The 199-char opening stands alone and does all three jobs: names the news trigger with its date, names the mechanism, and signals the correction without snark.

criteria.name: Mechanism load-bearing + AK consequence
criteria.notes: Consequence side is near-perfect: sector, named actors (Pendergast, Strupulis, Alyeska plus three owners), decision, timeframe (Sept. 10 federal, 5 p.m. Sept. 21 state), plus an explicit who-is-positioned ledger. The AI side is inferential by design, carried by the default-path-for-anything-else claim, which is true and defensible upstream but not a demonstrated Alaska AI capital or procurement decision, so the top descriptor is not met.
criteria.why: Consequence fully specified; AI side inferential by design, so the top descriptor is not met.

criteria.name: Layer fidelity
criteria.notes: All five body layers map one-to-one onto stack_anatomy layers[] with controlling actors intact, and layer 5 correctly honors the _validation_note correction, framed as an amendment to lease ADL 63574 adding about 26.1 acres rather than a second thirty-year renewal. Two small compressions keep it off 10: bullet 2 carries its actor by reference, and the 185(f) terms list silently drops survey from the statute string.
criteria.why: All five layers and actors trace to the dossier; the ADL 63574 correction is correctly carried.

criteria.name: Chokepoint clarity
criteria.notes: One layer, one actor, one binary, stated flatly, followed by the asymmetry proof (no committee vote, no rate case, no legislative concurrence). Carries the required EA hedge honestly via the -EA suffix and the Alaska Public Media attribution. Docked one point because the binary's second half sits thirty words from its antecedent.
criteria.why: One layer, one actor, one binary, with the asymmetry proved by naming the absent forums.

criteria.name: Structural read
criteria.notes: A real position grounded in the machinery rather than in attitude. The operative insight, that a thinner record supports a thinner stipulations package, one easier to issue and harder to contest for thirty years, is an argument that could be wrong, which is the test. Slightly below post_001 energy because it leaves the normative call to the closing question.
criteria.why: A real, falsifiable position grounded in how the machinery works.

criteria.name: Forward implication
criteria.notes: Names the cheapest action, the exact deadline, the cost of missing it, the second clock at ADL 63574, and both sides of the positioning ledger. With scoping six days out the instruction is live.
criteria.why: Concrete next decision point, both dates, and who is positioned and who is not.

criteria.name: Primary-source quality
criteria.notes: Every layer traces to statute text, the BLM press release, or the DNR public notice, all marked refetched_and_confirmed, and the chokepoint citation is the primary agency page. Not a 10 because the single load-bearing EA fact exists nowhere in BLM prose and rests on a suffix inference plus one secondary outlet; the post handles that honestly with inline attribution.
criteria.why: All layers primary and re-fetched; the EA fact rests on a suffix inference, handled with honest inline attribution.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Analytical, structural, position-taking and Alaska-first, no influencer cadence, no banned phrases. Runs tighter and more telegraphic than post_001, and the brand's plain-in-language standard slips where stipulations package, scoping and the NEPA instrument are used without definition.
criteria.why: On voice throughout, but several load-bearing terms go undefined for the non-docket reader.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: Inside both windows with clean short paragraphs, but bullets 2 and 5 pack a statute cite and multiple data points into single lines, and the AI-bridge paragraph was one unbroken sixty-word sentence. ORCHESTRATOR NOTE: the recommended fix was applied after scoring, splitting that sentence into three; this criterion would now score higher.
criteria.why: Bullet items exceed single-clause; the bridge sentence was the hardest to parse. Fix applied post-scoring.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Genuinely debatable, aimed straight at the chokepoint's binary, free of any CTA or rhetorical softener.
criteria.why: Debatable, tied to the chokepoint specifically, no CTA.
